WHY type IS registry:theme AND NOT registry:base — measured, shadcn CLI 4.21.0. A registry:base item's cssVars block is silently ignored: the files land, the CLI reports success, and not one token reaches globals.css. registry:theme applies them correctly. No error, no warning, visible only by diffing globals.css after an install.
